subject: Aurora Keep L3 embedded runtime

tier1.reason: Advisory failure: the approved reference is a multi-view neutral studio sheet while the render is an embedded phone-world crop containing the island, board and scenery. The diagnostic explicitly reported that the runtime render was not isolated, so literal pixel IoU is not a valid acceptance authority for this production mode.

decision: Use deterministic measurements as advisory evidence and apply the embedded-runtime visual contract, cross-view inspection and semantic part coverage as the acceptance authority.
